T012 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  (1 ≤ n →
      ∀ (q r ε : ℝ),
        dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
          0 < r →
            r ≤ 1 →
              0 < ε →
                ∃ K U,
                  E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                    (∀ (i : ↑K), (U i).Nonempty ∧ 0 < Metric.ediam (U i) ∧ Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) ∧
                      cost q U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
    ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n) ∧
        dimH E ≠ ∞ ∧
          Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
            (∃ R, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (j : Fin n), |x.ofLp j| ≤ R) ∧
              (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → content s δ E < ∞) ∧
                (n = 0 → E = univ ∧ dimH E = 0) ∧
                  (Function.Bijective fun p => join p.1 p.2) ∧
                    (∀ (x : V n) (t : ℝ), base (join x t) = x ∧ height (join x t) = t) ∧
                      (∀ (z : V (n + 1)), join (base z) (height z) = z) ∧
                        ∀ (x y : V n) (t u : ℝ), dist (join x t) (join y u) ^ 2 = dist x y ^ 2 + dist t u ^ 2) →
      1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q δ ε : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
            0 < δ →
              0 < ε → ∃ W, scaleCover δ (_root_.cylinder E) W ∧ cost (q + 1) W < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * √2 ^ (q + 1) * ε)
'Translation.T012' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
